title: Glazed Purpur
description: A resource pack that turns Glazed Terracotta into Purpur styled blocks.
body:
This is a simple resource pack that replaces Glazed Terracotta with Purpur blocks recolored to match the appropriate Glazed Terracotta. The different variants (Purpur Pillar, X-Axis Purpur Pillar, Z-Axis Purpur Pillar, and Purpur Block) can be accessed by the different blockstates of Glazed Terracotta (North, South, East, and West.)
